displayPattern: Amber LED on a Bryant 80% two-stage variable-speed furnace (troubleshooting guide TG-GFB80-02). Short flashes are the first digit and long flashes are the second. Code 15 is 1 short and 5 long
meaning: Blower motor lockout. The blower failed to reach 250 RPM, or failed to communicate, within 30 seconds after being turned on, in two successive heating cycles. The control auto-resets after 3 hours. The chart says to see status code 41.
causes: Blower did not reach 250 RPM within 30 seconds of being turned on, twice in a row during heating
Blower did not communicate within 30 seconds of being turned on, twice in a row during heating
diySteps: Count 1 short flash and 5 long flashes. The 3-hour auto-reset is not a repair
Technician: use status code 41, which this lockout points to, for the blower, the wiring, and the furnace control
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician if 15 is stored. Do not keep cycling power to clear the 3-hour timer.
sourceTitle: Bryant 80% variable-speed two-stage furnace troubleshooting guide (Catalog No. TG-GFB80-02)
